scope: Pitch and formants plus level-matched A/B in the embedded saved-voice editor
source: Doctor Doom: You mistake my patience for weakness.
limitations: RMS matching over the full recording is not perceptual LUFS matching.
Pitch/formant sound quality and artifacts require human listening.
Export preserves processing amplitude; A/B matching is monitoring-only.
Recently rendered recipes are cached so comparison and export use the same processed samples.
